AppLayout.jsx renders one universal shell (no conditional bifurcation) with V2 workflow sidebar (Home, Opportunities, Projects, Estimating, Financial, Expenses, Documents, Reports + Integrations, Settings, Profile), a persistent Brain button in the top-right header (data-testid=company-brain-btn), and no floating FABs. All 6 command-center pytest tests + all 7 workspace_context pytest tests pass.
critical_code_review_comments: AppLayout.jsx line 243: The background watermark uses inline style marginLeft: '200px'. This is intended to offset for the 256px (w-64) sidebar but the number does not match (should be 256px or use CSS variable). On very small desktop widths the shield may render slightly off-center. Cosmetic only.

AppLayout.jsx fetchWorkspaceContext runs once on mount but has no dependency on user/session change. If the user signs out and signs back in without a full reload, workspaceContext will remain stale. Consider re-fetching when user.id changes.

App.js Line 178-179: Legacy redirects <Route path="dashboard" element={<Navigate to="/app/command-center" replace />} /> - these are nested under /app, so they correctly resolve to /app/dashboard -> /app/command-center. However, if a user has a deep-linked path like /app/dashboard/settings, the redirect will drop everything after 'dashboard'. If any legacy deep links are known to exist (e.g., email links, PWA shortcuts), consider adding a catch-all /app/dashboard/* -> /app/command-center redirect.

CompanyBrainCard 'action_link' click still uses window.location.assign() (line 427 CommandCenterPage.jsx) which triggers a full page reload and drops React state. Prefer useNavigate(rec.action_link) for a smooth SPA transition. (Carried over from iteration 7 - not fixed.)

CommandCenterPage.jsx polling interval (setInterval every 60s, line 654) keeps calling fetchDashboardData even when the tab is hidden. Consider pausing on document.visibilityState !== 'visible'. (Carried over from iteration 7.)

Backend command_center.py verify_token_and_get_context() calls jwt.decode with options={'verify_signature': False}. Payload 'sub' is trusted; signature is not verified. A crafted JWT with a real user_id could pass this path if the admin lookup succeeds. Consider verifying via SUPABASE_JWT_SECRET / JWKS. (Carried over from iteration 7.)
